mana-ball.name: Mana Ball
mana-ball.description: Launch a Mana ball that deals ({{value1}})% damage to the target and can be catapulted 5 times, adding 3 catalputs if it kills the target.

rage.name: Rage
rage.description: Get {{value1}} Rage for each extra action.

full-blow.name: Full Blow
full-blow.description: Deals ({{value1}})% damage to the target while lacerating wound and inflicting [bleed] on the target

epidemic-spreading.name: Epidemic Spreading
epidemic-spreading.description: When attacking, if the target is in an abnormal status, ({{value1}})% probability on infection to other enemies

calling-servant.name: Calling Servant
calling-servant.description: After death, summon litle zombie to fight.

fire-sea.name: Fire Sea
fire-sea.description: Sacrifice yourself into a sea of fire, dealing ({{value1}})% damage to the front row target and [burning] the enemy.

light-up.name: Light-up
light-up.description: When attacking, if the target is burning, it will immediately trigger a burning damage

anomalous-fire.name: Anomalous Fire
anomalous-fire.description: Throe 8 fireballs in a row, dealing ({{value1}})% damage to random targets

shaping.name: Shaping
shaping.description: Each action loses 5% of current Health and summons a small flame.
